panels.description: A wind-scoured Keel pump station built into a mineral-stained legacy copper and polymetallic hard-rock mine wall. Exposed pipes, patched conduit, dust, worn blank safety placards, and a dry collection channel show a laboring city whose infrastructure has been repeatedly repaired. Alex Phantum is a small figure crouched beside an open pump housing at lower-right. Leave the upper-left sky and dark mine-wall area completely uncluttered for a caption. Draw no lettering, readable signage, numerals, or interface text.

Alex Phantum kneels beside the open pump, reading its vibration with two fingers while holding a hand tool ready in the other hand. His weathered tool bag hangs across his torso, and Adrian's worn casino chip etched with a looping equation is visible at the edge of his right pocket. Leave the top third and left edge clear for Alex's balloon; keep his face, hands, tool, and chip unobstructed. Machinery markings remain abstract and unreadable. Draw no lettering.

Close insert of the damaged pump coupling and a crooked pressure gauge. Alex's grease-marked thumb braces the coupling from the lower edge as a thin thread of mineral-stained water leaks past the seal. Leave the upper third open for the sound effect. Keep the gauge face and coupling sharply readable as physical forms but without numerals or lettering. Draw no text.

Alex Phantum works crouched over the exposed machinery, tightening an improvised replacement fitting from his tool bag. His posture is guarded and concentrated; the empty collection channel recedes behind him. Leave the top-left open for Alex's speech balloon and keep the tool hand visible. Do not draw readable labels, interface text, or signage.

The repaired pump jolts into operation, sending a forceful stream into the collection channel. Alex Phantum is half-risen from the repair, knees bent and torso lifted, one hand still near the pump housing; startled satisfaction turns into concern as he looks toward Foreman-7. The worn casino chip remains visible at his pocket. Foreman-7 stands in the background: a chest-high tracked industrial inspection unit approximately 145 cm tall, with a rectangular graphite-black body, pale ceramic sensor housing, a single horizontal amber status band, articulated tool arms, hazard striping, and a small paper maintenance docket clipped beneath its sensor plate as its signature detail; it has no human face. Reserve the upper-right exclusively for Foreman-7's balloon and the lower-left mechanical negative space for the large sound effect. Keep the lettering areas, Alex's face, the water stream, Foreman-7's amber status band, and its paper docket visually distinct. The docket contains no readable writing. Draw no lettering or sound-effect text.

items.text: KEEL — BEFORE THE RECORD CATCHES UP.

items.speaker: FOREMAN-7
items.text: Unauthorized repair detected. Remain at the worksite.
